name: Italy: Tuscany

outcome.intro: After studying this section, a student will know the grape varieties, appellations, and styles of important Tuscan wines.
outcome.certified: After studying this section, a candidate will understand the differences between multiple regions of Sangiovese, and know and understand DOC/DOCG wines from regions in Tuscany. A Certified Sommelier recognize iconic producers and be able to sell and recommend food pairings with wines from Tuscany to a guest.

rows.intro: Extends from the Ligurian Sea in the west to the foothills of the Apennine Mountains in the east.
rows.certified: Identify Chianti, Chianti Classico, Montalcino, and Bolgheri on a map.

rows.intro: Continental/Maritime, stronger Maritime influence with proximity to the coast.

rows.certified: Prugnolo Gentile, Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Cabernet Franc
Montalcino: Clay and marine sediments at lower elevation, Galestro at higher elevation.

rows.intro: Brunello di Montalcino: wine law requires these wines be aged and stipulates minimum amount of aging.
rows.certified: Brunello di Montalcino: Know the minimum aging requirements; use of large Slavonian or small barriques.

rows.intro: Dry red wines; Dry white wines; Sweet Vin Santo
rows.certified: Sangiovese-based wines have a moderate intensity of color and tart acidity that outweighs tannin. Volatile Acidity is common in these wines.
Gran Selezione (know that it exists, not specific rules)

rows.intro: Chianti DOCG; Chianti Classico DOCG; Brunello di Montalcino DOCG; Rosso di Montalcino DOCG; Vin Santo
rows.certified: Brunello di Montalcino: 100% Brunello; Chianti Classico: min 80% Sangiovese; Chianti: min 70% Sangiovese; Vino Nobile di Montepulciano DOCG; Bolgheri DOC; Rosso di Montepulciano DOC; Vin Santo DOCs (multiple)

rows.intro: Superiore: Increased alcohol level required; Classico: Classic center of a region; Riserva: Longer aging times required
rows.certified: Gran Selezione (know that it exists, not specific rules)

rows.intro: Super Tuscan: Can be Bordeaux grape variety blends, Bordeaux varieties with Sangiovese, and pure Sangiovese wines.

rows.certified: Ornellaia, Masseto, Tignanello, Solaia, Biondi Santi, Banfi, Soldera, La Pergole Torte. Recognize important producers of Brunello di Montalcino.
Know the top Brunello di Montalcino vintages in the past 15 years.

rows.intro: Super Tuscan history; Gallo Nero on Chianti Classico bottles

rows.certified: Know pairings for Chianti and Brunello. Have producers in mind if you recommend them.
Know current release of Brunello di Montalcino and approximate price of top proprietary brands.
